top_signals.title: Israel 'Fully Aligned' With Trump, Kushner on Hamas Disarmament Says Ophir Falk
top_signals.summary: Ophir Falk,  foreign policy advisor to Israel Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, said Israel is 'fully aligned' with President Trump and Jared Kushner when it comes to the need for Hamas to disarm for peace projects in Gaza to move forward. Falk said that Hamas could choose to lay down their arms in 'an afternoon' but Israel is prepared to do things 'the hard way' if they do not.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bernstein forecasts Bitcoin to reclaim $125K by late 2026 ahead of cycle peak
top_signals.summary: Bernstein expects Bitcoin to reclaim $125,000 by late 2026, before reaching $300,000 in 2029 under its base case, with a bull case of $500,000.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Meta pledges to overhaul kids’ safety protections, pay $17 billion to settle social media case
top_signals.summary: A multibillion-dollar settlement with attorneys general from nearly every U.S. state and territory will mean new privacy and safety protections in Meta products.
